ratings.notes: Radical challenges authority/oppression; centrist adheres to norms. Radical can be loyal to a cause.
Love-focused relates to kindness and nurturance.
Transparent relates to honesty; Machiavellian to dishonesty and immorality.
Prudish relates to chastity/modesty; flirtatious can relate to promiscuity/indecency.
Innocent relates to purity and blamelessness.
Touchy-feely relates to empathy and care.
Often crying can indicate suffering, relating to care/harm.
Hugs relate to amity and care.
Homebody relates to family/communal loyalty; world traveler can imply less group affiliation.
Naughty/nice are general moral judgments; nice also implies kindness.
Junkie/straight edge directly relate to purity/impurity and self-discipline.
Dystopian/utopian relate to suffering/peace, justice/injustice, oppression/freedom, and general good/evil.
Parental relates to care/protection and authority/duty. Childlike can relate to innocence/purity.
